items.title: AI News Today, October 16, 2026: Top Stories Explained

items.title: Release Notes | liteLLM
items.summary: LiteLLM released version v1.105.0 on Oct 11 2026, adding support for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT‑6.1 Sol, a new Decisions API across eight providers, and the litellm.agent() function for building coding agents via the gateway. The release also introduces Lens with Agent Traces for observability. Breaking‑change notes are provided for safe upgrades.
items.why: Provides concrete, up‑to‑date library features that software engineers can immediately integrate into LLM‑powered applications and agents.

items.why: Provides concrete, actionable instructions for deploying Claude Code via LiteLLM, saving engineers time and avoiding common pitfalls.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5: 5 settings that return 400 when ...
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 were released in September 2026 and introduce five API settings that now return HTTP 400 errors when only the model name is changed. The article details the breaking changes for the "thinking" parameter, forced tool_choice, and other fields, and provides example request code for both versions. An open‑source scanner (claude5-migration-kit) is offered to locate these problematic settings in codebases.
items.why: Helps engineers quickly adapt existing Claude‑based applications to the new model versions and avoid runtime errors.

items.title: Claude Code Compatibility | liteLLM
items.summary: The Claude Code compatibility matrix page shows a daily‑generated table that verifies which LiteLLM releases work with Claude Code across model tiers (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7). It links to the JSON source and the test suite that populates the matrix.
items.why: Engineers can quickly confirm whether their LiteLLM version supports the latest Claude Code models before integrating.
